title: Fixed-degree shift compatibility of the evaluation transpose
statement: For a scheme X, a homomorphism A→B of commutative rings and a derived A-module sheaf M, let v be the evaluation-transpose comparison. Give the two contravariant Hom functors evaluation-normalized integer shifts sA,sB, and give EtaleHomLeft and EtaleHomRight integer shifts chiPhi,chiPsi satisfying the two component equations in IsEtaleHomReversedExact: chiPhi = F(sA) followed by the canonical scalar shift, and chiPsi = Hom of the inverse scalar shift followed by sB. Then for each integer n, NatTrans.CommShiftCore v n holds for these same chiPhi,chiPsi.

source.place: Tags 08JC and 08J9: signed shift square for the evaluation transpose

proof.text: Unfold NatTrans.CommShiftCore to its components at op K. Rewrite the two composite-shift components by hPhi and hPsi; the resulting equation is the fixed-degree component equation for K and n, by the fixed-degree component lemma (the shift of op K in the opposite category is op of K shifted by -n, definitionally).

proof_origin.place: Tags 08JC and 08J9; categorical transposition of the normalized shift square, with tensor balancing isolated

lean.statement:
theorem etaleHomComparison_reversedExact_commShift_core
    {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (φ : A →+* B) (M : DerivedCategoryModule A X)
    (v : EtaleHomLeft X φ M ⟶ EtaleHomRight X φ M)
    (hv : IsEtaleHomTranspose X φ M v)
    (sA : ((derivedHom (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X).flip.obj M).CommShift ℤ)
    (sB : ((derivedHom (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) X).flip.obj
      ((scalarExtension φ X).obj M)).CommShift ℤ)
    (_chiPhi : (EtaleHomLeft X φ M).CommShift ℤ)
    (_chiPsi : (EtaleHomRight X φ M).CommShift ℤ)
    (hA : EtaleHomShiftNormalization (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X M sA)
    (hB : EtaleHomShiftNormalization (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) X
      ((scalarExtension φ X).obj M) sB)
    (hPhi :
      letI := etaleHomScalarCommShift X φ
      letI := _chiPhi
      ∀ (K : DerivedCategoryModule A X) (n : ℤ),
        ((EtaleHomLeft X φ M).commShiftIso n).hom.app (op K) =
          (scalarExtension φ X).map ((sA.commShiftIso n).hom.app (op K)) ≫
            ((scalarExtension φ X).commShiftIso n).hom.app
              (((derivedHom (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X).flip.obj M).obj (op K)))
    (hPsi :
      letI := etaleHomScalarCommShift X φ
      letI := _chiPsi
      ∀ (K : DerivedCategoryModule A X) (n : ℤ),
        ((EtaleHomRight X φ M).commShiftIso n).hom.app (op K) =
          ((derivedHom (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) X).flip.obj
              ((scalarExtension φ X).obj M)).map
            ((((scalarExtension φ X).commShiftIso (-n)).inv.app K).op) ≫
          (sB.commShiftIso n).hom.app (op ((scalarExtension φ X).obj K)))
    (n : ℤ) :
    letI := etaleHomScalarCommShift X φ
    letI := _chiPhi
    letI := _chiPsi
    NatTrans.CommShiftCore v n

statement_change.old_statement: For each integer n, the normalized evaluation transpose v satisfies NatTrans.CommShiftCore v n; equivalently, its shift square commutes in degree n.
statement_change.what: The old Lean signature allowed arbitrary chiPhi and chiPsi, although hA and hB normalized only sA and sB. Twisting just chiPhi by the character n↦(-1)^n leaves every old premise unchanged and reverses its degree-one square for a nonzero comparison (take identity coefficient change over Q). Thus the arbitrary-structure formulation is false. Add the two composite-shift component equations already supplied by shiftData and already required by IsEtaleHomReversedExact. The final exactness theorem and every target statement keep their signatures.
